title: Generator Runtime Engine — System Overview
description: A spec in, working software out: the engine renders templates, writes a project, executes it with node, and runs its tests.

title: Specification Schema — What the Engine Accepts
t: Specification Schema — What the Engine Accepts
description: A spec needs a name, file templates, and optionally typed fields and test declarations.

title: Validation Rejects Bad Specs Before Anything Is Built
t: Validation Rejects Bad Specs Before Anything Is Built
description: Malformed specifications are refused with explicit errors — nothing is generated from a broken spec.

title: Template Engine — {{placeholders}} Become Real Code
description: Templates substitute {{name}}, {{description}}, and typed {{field:name}} markers deterministically.

title: File Generation — Specs Become Project Directories
t: File Generation — Specs Become Project Directories
description: generate() writes every templated file into a fresh directory and refuses to overwrite an existing one.

title: Runtime Execution — Generated Code Actually Runs
t: Runtime Execution — Generated Code Actually Runs
description: runProject() executes the generated entry file with node and captures exit code, stdout, and stderr.

title: Test Execution — Declared Tests Run Against Real Output
t: Test Execution — Declared Tests Run Against Real Output
description: Tests are commands plus expected output; a test passes only if the program exits 0 and prints what was expected.

title: Generated Program: Greeter — Full Build Evidence
t: Generated Program: Greeter — Full Build Evidence
description: Spec → files → execution → passing test, on a greeting program built from a three-line spec.

title: Generated Program: Word Counter — Full Build Evidence
t: Generated Program: Word Counter — Full Build Evidence
description: A second artifact: counts words in its arguments, generated and verified by the engine.

title: Generated Program: Square Lister — Full Build Evidence
t: Generated Program: Square Lister — Full Build Evidence
description: A third artifact: lists squares 1..n, generated and verified by the engine.

title: Interfaces — What the Engine Exposes
description: validateSpec, renderTemplate, generate, runProject, runTests, and the full build() cycle.

title: Usage Guide — From Spec to Running Program in One Call
t: Usage Guide — From Spec to Running Program in One Call
description: build(spec, outDir, runArgs) is the whole pipeline: validate, generate, run, test.

title: Limits and Honest Boundaries
description: The engine generates JavaScript for node only; it cannot compile other languages, reach the network, or invent capabilities.

title: Integration — Generator Output Feeds the Verification Lab
t: Integration — Generator Output Feeds the Verification Lab
description: The lab verifies what the engine builds: this record runs the real handoff the master performs.

title: Verification Ladder — proposed, generated, executable, tested
t: Verification Ladder — proposed, generated, executable, tested
description: A spec climbs the ladder only by passing gates: generated on write, executable on clean run, tested on passing tests.
